en.summary: Fixes the N==1 base case of the one-hot encoder so the encoded index is always zero when the single input is asserted.
why_it_counts: The patch corrects active RTL in a reusable hardware primitive.
The bug changes the functional output value for a legal input case.
The fix is isolated and directly tied to the module's encoding semantics.
evidence: In the N == 1 branch, data_out changes from data_in to 0 while valid_out remains data_in.
For a one-input one-hot encoder, the only valid encoded index is zero.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A one-hot encoder instantiated with exactly one input has a degenerate but well-defined result: if the input is valid, the encoded index must be 0 because there is only one selectable position. Mirroring the input bit into the encoded output turns the valid case into index 1, which violates the primitive's contract and can break any client that expects a legal zero-based index.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The encoder is instantiated with one input and that input is asserted.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Drive the encoded output from the input bit instead of forcing the sole legal index 0.
portability_notes: This maps to any priority, one-hot, or valid-index encoder that has a special-case path for one entry.
The bug only affects the N==1 specialization; general N>1 logic can remain correct.
A simple reproduction is any client module that instantiates a one-entry encoder and uses the index output.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the encoder's degenerate or base-case branch for a single input entry.
Change the encoded index assignment from constant zero to the raw input bit.
Leave the valid output unchanged so the client sees a valid transaction with an impossible index.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit changes the N==1 branch so data_out is constant zero while valid_out still reflects data_in.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In the N == 1 branch, change data_out back from 0 to data_in.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Clients that instantiate a one-entry encoder receive a valid indication paired with an impossible encoded index of 1 instead of 0.
evidence_for_injection: The only functional change in the commit is the base-case data_out assignment.
valid_out is intentionally left unchanged, which isolates the bug to index encoding semantics.
The rest of the file is formatting-preserving churn around the same logic.
notes: This is a minimal and highly portable primitive-level mutation.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 one-hot 编码器在 N==1 特殊分支中的错误：当唯一输入有效时，编码索引应始终为 0。
why_it_counts: 补丁修复的是一个可复用硬件原语中的有效 RTL 逻辑。
该缺陷会在合法输入场景下直接改变功能输出值。
修复位置局部且清晰，直接对应编码语义。
evidence: 在 N == 1 分支中，data_out 从 data_in 改成了 0，而 valid_out 仍保持为 data_in。
对于单输入 one-hot 编码器，唯一合法的编码索引只能是 0。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当 one-hot 编码器只实例化了一个输入时，结果虽然是退化情形，但语义非常明确：如果输入有效，编码索引必须是 0，因为只有一个可选位置。如果把输入位直接镜像到编码输出，那么有效场景下就会产生索引 1，这违反了该原语的基本约定，并会破坏任何依赖合法零基索引的下游模块。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 单入口编码器的基础分支处理
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 编码器被实例化为单输入，并且该输入被置位。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让编码输出直接取输入位，而不是固定为唯一合法索引 0。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 退化场景处理逻辑错误
portability_notes: 这可映射到任何对单入口情况做特殊处理的 priority encoder、one-hot encoder 或 valid-index encoder。
该缺陷只影响 N==1 的特化路径，N>1 的通用逻辑可以保持正确。
一个简单复现场景是任何实例化单入口编码器并使用其 index 输出的客户端模块。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到编码器针对单入口情形的退化或基础分支。
把编码索引赋值从常数零改成原始输入位。
保持 valid 输出不变，使下游看到的是“有效事务配上不可能的索引”。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_onehot_encoder 的 N == 1 特化分支
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交把 N==1 分支中的 data_out 改为常数 0，同时保持 valid_out 仍由 data_in 决定。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 N == 1 分支中，把 data_out 从 0 改回 data_in。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 实例化单入口编码器的下游模块会收到“valid 为真但编码索引为 1”这种不可能的组合，而正确结果应为 0。
evidence_for_injection: 该提交中唯一功能性改动就是基础分支的 data_out 赋值。
valid_out 被刻意保持不变，因此缺陷被隔离在索引编码语义上。
其余差异基本都是围绕同一逻辑的格式化整理。
notes: 这是一个非常小且高度可移植的原语级注入点。
